gateway.autoStartDesc: Start Gateway when Verse Claw launches
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.

gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.

memoryEmbedding.disableEffect: When off, memory retrieval falls back to local 3-gram TF-IDF matching with zero regression. Enable after configuring at least one embedding provider.

dcsProdFlags.title: DCS Controlled Preview Flags
dcsProdFlags.description: Advanced opt-in DCS (BlockStore) control plane for working memory, context tools, and related flags. Defaults stay off/shared/shadow; this panel is not release approval. Writable switches save app settings and, for config flags, openclaw.json, then restart a running gateway.
dcsProdFlags.readOnlyNote: This row is documentation-only (api/request/baseline). Use the switch rows for writable opt-in flags, or advanced env/config as documented in docs/dcs-production-p0-runbook.md.
dcsProdFlags.enableViaSettings: Use the switch above (Settings control plane). Advanced: env/config as in runbook.
dcsProdFlags.rollbackViaSettings: Turn the switch off (Settings). Gateway restarts when running.
dcsProdFlags.pendingRestartToast: Saved. Gateway restart pending or failed — flag may apply on next start.

ackHint.gatewayNotRunning: Saved. The gateway is not running, so no child could confirm it. Start the gateway to apply.
ackHint.restartFailed: Saved, but the gateway restart failed. Restart the gateway manually, then refresh.
ackHint.ackTimeoutRunning: Saved and restarted, but the runtime did not confirm in time. Refresh, or restart the gateway again.
ackHint.ackTimeoutStopped: The gateway stopped before confirming. Check the gateway logs, then start it again.
ackHint.ackIncomplete: The runtime replied with an incomplete acknowledgement, so this is not confirmed as applied. Check the gateway version and logs.
ackHint.staleGeneration: Only the previous gateway process answered. The new process has not confirmed — restart again and refresh.
ackHint.flagRejected: The runtime did not adopt every requested flag. Open the details to see which ones and why.

vtokenBridge.title: Verse Token Bridge
vtokenBridge.description: Opt-in Verse Token Working Context packing (source assembly). When enabled, it packs workspace md/tools/memory into ## Working Context on agent turns. It does not replace on-disk markdown or DCS BlockStore. Kill-switch: VERSE_VTOKEN_ASSEMBLY_ENABLED=0.
vtokenBridge.enableHelp: Process-local host-api bridge for diagnostics. Turn assembly remains off until explicitly enabled; when enabled, the gateway owns the turn path.
vtokenBridge.boundaryNote: Layer map: CVK = navigation shell · DCS = BlockStore memory/tools · VT = Working Context packing. VT consumes md/jsonl as sources only; it does not replace DCS ContextBlock/BlockStore/compaction.
vtokenBridge.loadFailed: Failed to load VT bridge status: {{error}}
vtokenBridge.enabledToast: VT bridge enabled (worker still lazy-starts on first use)

contextLayers.title: How context layers differ (do not confuse)
contextLayers.cvkBody: Default context engine shell: injects routing / tool-navigation metadata into the system prompt. It does **not** mean working memory or long-term knowledge is on. Turning DCS or VToken off does not remove this shell unless you change the context-engine slot.
contextLayers.dcsBody: Opt-in BlockStore spine: working-memory injection, tool_registry summary, knowledge blocks, and context_* tools. Defaults stay fail-closed until you enable flags here. This is real memory/content plumbing — not the CVK navigation shell.
contextLayers.vtokenBody: Assembles workspace md/tools/memory into a ## Working Context pack for the turn. Source packaging only: it does **not** replace DCS BlockStore, on-disk markdown, or claim that “the context engine remembered everything.”
contextLayers.footer: If only CVK is active, the model may see navigation chrome without your DCS/VToken content. Enable DCS flags and/or VToken deliberately after reading each panel.

dcsPreview.title: DCS Coding Controlled Preview
dcsPreview.description: Status: opt-in. One switch for the first-product capability combo: context read/search/view tools, working-memory and tool-registry context blocks, and the stale-write guard. Write journal + undo are always on. Default off; never auto-enabled by upgrades.
